purpose.zh: 活动髋部，提升髋外旋和外展能力
purpose.en: Mobilize the hip through external rotation and abduction.

text.zh: 膝盖抬到髋高，向外侧打开再放下
text.en: Lift your knee to hip height, swing it out to the side, then lower

text.zh: 一手扶椅背，骨盆和躯干保持朝前
text.en: Hold the chair back and keep your pelvis and trunk facing forward.

text.zh: 再沿反方向做一次关门
text.en: Then reverse the circle to close the gate.

commonErrors.en: Turning or leaning the body with the leg.

cautions.zh: 髋不适时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your hip feels uncomfortable, and stop if it still hurts.

cautions.zh: 使用稳固、不带轮子的椅子
cautions.en: Use a sturdy chair without wheels.
